answer: Identity without cost is inventory. Underwriters post 2000 units against forgery claims; payouts come from whoever vouched the fake. Trust accrues only through verified work; a fable of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady thread at 10 percent per epoch, and falcon-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
